name: Timber Town

categories.label: Green parks (per scoring card)
categories.hint: Points per the green scoring card in play (Garden/Playground/Estate/Arboretum).

categories.label: Purple temples (per scoring card, incl. Shrine +6 majority)
categories.hint: Points per the purple scoring card (Shrine/Hermitage/Monastery/Pagoda); Shrine adds +6 for more purple tiles than opponent.

categories.label: Orange markets (per scoring card)
categories.hint: Points per the orange scoring card (Food/Textile/Flower/Luxury).

categories.label: Blue workshops (per scoring card)
categories.hint: Points per the blue scoring card (Cooper/Tailor/Carpenter/Blacksmith).

categories.label: Yellow homes (per scoring card)
categories.hint: Points per the yellow scoring card (Cottage/Cabin/Chalet/Lodge).

categories.label: Beaver tokens that can cross the town
categories.labelVi: Beaver token đi xuyên thị trấn
categories.hint: 5 per beaver token able to travel left edge to right edge via connected boardwalks, passing its brown tile.

categories.label: Unused construction tokens
categories.hint: 1 per unused construction token, including a one-colour raft.

categories.label: Builder beaver (first to fill 16 spaces)
categories.labelVi: Builder beaver (lấp đầy 16 ô đầu tiên)
categories.hint: 5 points to the first player to fill all 16 town spaces.

tiebreakers.description: Player who took the builder beaver wins; if neither did, the win is shared.

notes: family: tile-placement-pattern. Scoring cards differ each game (one per colour: green, purple, orange, blue, yellow; red and brown fixed), so tile-colour points are scorer inputs computed from that game's cards (appendix lists all card variants). Brown tiles score nothing themselves. Game ends when neither player can claim another tile.

sources.title: Timber Town Rulebook (Alley Cat Games, linked from publisher page)
sources.section: End Game; Scoring (p. 8); Appendix: Building Tiles (pp. 10-15)
